# Retrieve user posts

Updated: Apr 14, 2026

This document shows you how to retrieve:

- A list of all posts created by an app-scoped user
- A list of all posts created by a public profile
- A single Threads media object
- A list of all ghost posts created by an app-scoped user

**Note:** To retrieve posts that are replies, refer to [Retrieve user replies](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/threads/retrieve-and-manage-replies/retrieve-replies).

## Retrieve a list of an app-scoped user’s posts

Use the `GET /{threads-user-id}/threads` endpoint to return a paginated list of all posts created by a user.

Retrieving posts requires an appropriate access token and permissions based on the endpoint you are calling. While you are testing, you can generate tokens and grant your app permissions by using the Graph API Explorer.

- `threads_basic` — Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.

### Limitations

- You can only fetch a paginated list of all posts created by the app-scoped user.

### Fields

Here is a list of fields that can be returned for each post.

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` *(default)* | The media’s ID. |
| `media_product_type` | Surface where the media is published. In the case of Threads, the value is `THREADS`. |
| `media_type` | The media type for a Threads post is one of these values: `TEXT_POST`, `IMAGE`, `VIDEO`, `CAROUSEL_ALBUM`, `AUDIO`, or `REPOST_FACADE`. **Note:** `media_type` returns `TEXT_POST` for posts containing GIFs and polls. |
| `media_url` | The post’s media URL. |
| `permalink` | Permanent link to the post. Omitted if the media contains copyrighted material or has been flagged for a copyright violation. |
| `owner` | ID of the Threads user who created the post. **Note:** This is only available on top-level posts that you own. |
| `username` | Username of the Threads user who created the post. |
| `text` | Represents text for a Threads post. |
| `timestamp` | Post time. The publish date in ISO 8601 format. |
| `shortcode` | Shortcode of the media. |
| `thumbnail_url` | URL of thumbnail. This only shows up for Threads media with video. |
| `children` | List of child posts. This only shows up for carousel posts. |
| `is_quote_post` | Whether the media is a quote post made by another user. |
| `quoted_post` | Media ID of the post that was quoted. **Note:** This only appears on quote posts. |
| `reposted_post` | Media ID of the post that was reposted. **Note:** This only appears on reposts. |
| `alt_text` | The accessibility text label or description for an image or video in a Threads post. |
| `link_attachment_url` | The URL attached to a Threads post. |
| `gif_url` | The URL of the GIF attached to the post (if any). **Note:** This only appears on posts that have a GIF attachment. |
| `poll_attachment` | The poll attachment for the post. **Note:** This only appears on posts that have a poll. |
| `topic_tag` | The topic tag in the post’s header (if any). **Note:** This only appears on posts that have a topic tag. |
| `is_spoiler_media` | Whether the media was posted as a spoiler. |
| `text_entities` | Whether the `text` field of the post contains spoilers. |
| `text_attachment` | The text attachment for the post. |
| `ghost_post_status` | The status of a ghost post. **Values:** - `ACTIVE` — An active ghost post. - `ARCHIVED` — An expired ghost post. **Note:** This only appears on ghost posts. |
| `ghost_post_expiration_timestamp` | Timestamp of when the post expires or expired, in ISO 8601 format. **Note:** This only appears on ghost posts. |
| `is_verified` | Whether the post author’s profile is verified on Threads. |
| `profile_picture_url` | Returns the URL of the post author’s profile picture on Threads. |

### Example request

```
curl -s -X GET \
"https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/me/threads?fields=id,media_product_type,media_type,media_url,permalink,owner,username,text,topic_tag,timestamp,shortcode,thumbnail_url,children,is_quote_post&since=2023-10-15&until=2023-11-18&limit=1&access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### Example response

```
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "1234567",
      "media_product_type": "THREADS",
      "media_type": "TEXT_POST",
      "permalink": "https://www.threads.com/@threadsapitestuser/post/abcdefg",
      "owner": {
        "id": "1234567"
      },
      "username": "threadsapitestuser",
      "text": "Today Is Monday",
      "topic_tag": "Mondays",
      "timestamp": "2023-10-17T05:42:03+0000",
      "shortcode": "abcdefg",
      "is_quote_post": false
    }
  ],
  "paging": {
    "cursors": {
      "before": "BEFORE_CURSOR",
      "after": "AFTER_CURSOR"
    }
  }
}
```

## Retrieve a list of a public profile’s posts

Use the `GET /profile_posts?username=...` endpoint to look up a public profile and retrieve a paginated list of their posts on Threads.

The Threads Profile Discovery API requires an appropriate access token and permissions based on the endpoint you are calling. While you are testing, you can generate tokens and grant your app permissions by using the Graph API Explorer.

- `threads_basic` — Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.
- `threads_profile_discovery` — Required for making any calls to all Threads Profile Discovery API endpoints.

With [standard access](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/development/graph-api/overview/access-levels), only posts from some of the official Meta accounts can be retrieved. These include @meta, @threads, @instagram, and @facebook.

### Limitations

- Only returns public profiles with at least 100 followers.
- A user can send a maximum of 1,000 requests within a rolling 24-hour period. Once a query is sent, it counts against this limit for 24 hours.

### Parameters

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `access_token` string | **Required.** Threads API user access token. |
| `username` string | **Required.** Unique username on Threads. Must be an exact match. |

### Fields

### Example request

```
curl -i -X GET \
  "https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/profile_posts?access_token=<THREADS_TESTER_ACCESS_TOKEN>&username=<THREADS_USERNAME>&fields=id,media_product_type,media_type,media_url,permalink,username,text,topic_tag,timestamp,shortcode,thumbnail_url,children,is_quote_post&since=2023-10-15&until=2023-11-18&limit=1"
```

### Example response

```
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "1234567",
      "media_product_type": "THREADS",
      "media_type": "TEXT_POST",
      "permalink": "https://www.threads.com/@meta/post/abcdefg",
      "username": "meta",
      "text": "Today Is Monday",
      "topic_tag": "Mondays",
      "timestamp": "2023-10-17T05:42:03+0000",
      "shortcode": "abcdefg",
      "is_quote_post": true
    }
  ],
  "paging": {
    "cursors": {
      "before": "BEFORE_CURSOR",
      "after": "AFTER_CURSOR"
    }
  }
}
```

You can also use the `GET /{threads-media-id}` endpoint to return a single Threads media object.

Retrieving a single Threads media object requires an appropriate access token and permissions based on the endpoint you are calling. While you are testing, you can generate tokens and grant your app permissions by using the Graph API Explorer.

- `threads_basic` — Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.

If your app has not been approved for [advanced access](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/development/graph-api/overview/access-levels) for the `threads_basic` permission, only posts created by a Threads tester are retrievable. After approval, public posts created by other users are retrievable.

### Fields

### Example request

```
curl -s -X GET \
"https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/<THREADS_MEDIA_ID>?fields=id,media_product_type,media_type,media_url,permalink,owner,username,text,topic_tag,timestamp,shortcode,thumbnail_url,children,is_quote_post&access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>"
```

### Example response

```
{
  "id": "1234567",
  "media_product_type": "THREADS",
  "media_type": "TEXT_POST",
  "permalink": "https://www.threads.com/@threadsapitestuser/post/abcdefg",
  "owner": {
    "id": "1234567"
  },
  "username": "meta",
  "text": "Today Is Monday",
  "topic_tag": "Mondays",
  "timestamp": "2023-10-09T23:18:27+0000",
  "shortcode": "abcdefg",
  "is_quote_post": false
}
```

## Retrieve a list of an app-scoped user’s ghost posts

Use the `GET /{threads-user-id}/ghost_posts` endpoint to return a paginated list of all ghost posts created by an app-scoped user.

Retrieving ghost posts requires an appropriate access token and permissions based on the endpoint you are calling. While you are testing, you can generate tokens and grant your app permissions by using the [Graph API Explorer](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/).

- `threads_basic` — Required for making any calls to all Threads API endpoints.

If your app has not been approved for advanced access for the `threads_basic` permission, only posts created by a Threads tester are retrievable. After approval, public posts created by other users are retrievable.

### Fields

### Example request

```
curl -s -G \
  -d "fields=id,media_product_type,media_type,media_url,permalink,owner,username,text,timestamp,shortcode,thumbnail_url,ghost_post_status,ghost_post_expiration_timestamp" \
  -d "since=<START_DATE>" \
  -d "until=<END_DATE>" \
  -d "limit=1" \
  -d "access_token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>" \
"https://graph.threads.com/v1.0/me/ghost_posts"
```

### Example response

```
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "<MEDIA_ID>",
      "media_product_type": "THREADS",
      "media_type": "TEXT_POST",
      "permalink": "https://www.threads.com/<THREADS_USERNAME>/post/<POST_ID>",
      "owner": {
        "id": "<THREADS_USER_ID>"
      },
      "username": "<THREADS_USERNAME>",
      "text": "<TEXT>",
      "timestamp": "<TIMESTAMP>",
      "shortcode": "<MEDIA_SHORTCODE>",
      "ghost_post_status": "ARCHIVED",
      "ghost_post_expiration_timestamp": "<EXPIRATION_TIMESTAMP>"
    }
  ],
  "paging": {
    "cursors": {
      "before": "BEFORE_CURSOR",
      "after": "AFTER_CURSOR"
    }
  }
}
```
